Method of Attack: An authenticated attacker sends a specially crafted UDP packet to execute commands on the vacuum cleaner as root by exploiting the UDP command 153 vulnerability. The crafted UDP packet runs "/mnt/skyeye/mode_switch.sh %s" with attacker-controlled input.
Discoverer: Positive Technologies researchers Leonid Krolle and Georgy Zaytsev
Impacted Systems: potentially other Dongguan devices such as DVRs, surveillance cameras, and smart doorbells
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation by an authenticated attacker using default admin password 888888
Physical access via microSD card insertion for firmware replacement
Method of Attack: Remote code execution with superuser privileges via crafted UDP packet
Firmware replacement with malicious version via microSD card without digital signature verification
Attack Vector: Remote authenticated attack exploiting default password
